listing.name: Parasite Eve / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Build and play Parasite Eve on Windows or Linux with your own matching USA two-disc set and retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. The Mac setup kit uses upstream preparation.

steps.title: Use the exact original files
steps.instruction: Use your own Parasite Eve (USA) two-disc set (SLUS-00662, SLUS-00668), each disc with its single data track, and your own retail SCPH-1001 BIOS.

steps.title: Set up the managed Windows or Linux player
steps.instruction: In Portcove, select the complete matching CHD for every disc in order, and the BIOS. Keep the original files in place. Portcove builds the player with its registered toolchain. Choose the disc when you choose Play. To change discs, use the game’s own disc change if it offers one, or quit and choose Play with the next disc.

steps.title: Prepare a separate Mac copy
steps.instruction: Choose the official Mac ZIP from the upstream releases: -macos-x64.zip for Intel or -macos-arm64.zip for Apple silicon, and extract it. Follow its README-SETUP.txt, which asks for your own SCPH-1001 BIOS.

steps.title: Build and add the completed Mac player
steps.instruction: Run Parasite_Eve from the kit folder, assign both discs in Disc Selection and choose Generate & rebuild. In Portcove, select build-release/Parasite_Eve as the player and build-release as its start folder.

warnings: Portcove checks each disc’s data track and track count. Keep every disc intact.
Upstream reports that each disc starts. A change to Disc 2 during play hasn’t been tested.
Mac setup, replacement and backups belong to you and the upstream kit. Native setup, gameplay and populated-save behavior remain unverified.

references.title: Keep the original files and your data
references.instruction: Keep your discs and BIOS separately. For a Mac copy, close the game and back up the complete working folder and its saves, settings and installed mods before replacing the kit.

presentation.manual_preparation: Provide your own single-track CHDs for SLUS-00662 and SLUS-00668 in disc order and retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. Portcove verifies each disc’s data track and builds a private player with its registered toolchain, retaining its declared saves, settings and installed mods. Choose the disc when you choose Play. To change discs, use the game’s own disc change if it offers one, or quit and choose Play with the next disc. Upstream reports that each disc starts; a change to Disc 2 during play hasn’t been tested. Bundled mods belong to the runtime version. Windows and Linux package and source fit were statically inspected. Native build, disc switching, gameplay and save compatibility remain unobserved.
